name_first.comment:
The first name of a contact (will return records that have a 1:1 match -
if name_last also provided, parameters are used together)

name_last.comment:
The last name of a contact (will return records that have a 1:1 match -
if name_first also provided, parameters are used together)

contact_type.comment: (optional) Limit duplicate checking to either a person or company

min_user_relationship_to_contact.comment:
(optional) If provided (none,
read, update, owner), will filter results to only include contacts that the user has at least this
level of relationship with. Must be one of: 'none', 'read', 'owner', 'update'

match_behaviour.comment:
(optional)
- "classic": must match on name and phone, name and email, or phone or email. if full name provided but
  email or phone is not, no result will be returned. Behaviour is different when only first or last name
  is provided.
- "strict": if name is provided, must match name AND (phone OR email) if either are provided
